no-unguarded-getElementById.description: document.getElementById() result must be null-checked before property access

no-unguarded-querySelector.description: querySelector/querySelectorAll result must be null-checked before property access

no-unsafe-inline-onclick.description: Dynamic template literals inside onclick attributes must escape apostrophes

no-unguarded-closest-chain.description: .closest() result must be null-checked before property access

balanced-script-tags.description: Every <script> tag must have a matching </script>

fetch-must-have-catch.description: Every fetch() chain should have a .catch() or be inside try/catch

no-unguarded-dom-variable.description: Variables assigned from getElementById/querySelector must be null-checked before property access

add-to-cart-response-status-check.description: Add-to-cart fetch handlers must verify response.ok or response.status to prevent silent failures

cart-drawer-sync-integrity.description: Add-to-cart handlers must synchronize with #sp-cart-drawer rather than defunct <cart-drawer>

button-disabled-finally-guarantee.description: Disabled/loading buttons must have guaranteed re-enabling in finally/catch blocks

form-variant-id-completeness.description: Forms submitting to /cart/add must declare a name=id input

checkout-url-integrity.description: Checkout buttons and redirects must point to valid /checkout destinations

no-missing-snippet-assets.description: Every Liquid {% render %} or {% include %} must reference a snippet file that exists on disk

bundle-inventory-availability-guard.description: All bundle/box slot addition functions must explicitly guard against available === false items

no-swallowed-cart-error-message.description: Cart error catch blocks must propagate dynamic err.message from Shopify and not swallow with generic alerts
